blockers.title: The F1R3-5 fix silently drops a student again when the first word in the name cell is a heading keyword. The self-review and next steps say this case is fixed or not affected
blockers.scenario: A laid-out table row has a name, telephone, age and birth date, and the word 'anni' is misread ('annl'). The names tried were 'Sabato Marco', 'Corso Marta' (surname first) and 'Domenica Rossi' (given name first). The row gives no candidate and no unread notice: the student vanishes (probes final/parser K1-K3). With the age read (K4) the row is kept. The round-3 tree kept these rows; the keyword-first exception added for F1R3-5 drops them again, as the 5c1e029 baseline did. SC-12 says 'fixed … in a table layout, a name cell beside a date or telephone; residual on crops without either'. The next steps say the drop happens only 'on a crop without a table layout when the row has no printed age, date or telephone'. Both claims are false for this input, and they tell the owner that table photos with dates are safe from the drop.
blockers.suggestedFix: Preferred: never drop a laid-out row with at least 2 name-cell words beside a date or telephone. When its first word is a keyword, keep it with a row warning so it cannot be ready, and remove it only when the date is on or after the page's own print or course date. At minimum, reword SC-12 and the next-steps bullet to include table-layout rows whose first name-cell word is a keyword and whose age word is unread, and add a test that pins the chosen behaviour.

blockers.title: After the history rewrite, the shared primary clone can republish the old history on an ordinary pull and push. The warning reaches only the owner, not the agents
blockers.location: docs/post-mvp/0_3_0_QUESTIONS.md:20-30; AGENTS.md §13 (no rule); primary clone the main checkout (Desktop/CVC_helper)
blockers.scenario: `git worktree list` shows the primary clone on codex/0.3.0 at 5c1e029, which is pre-rewrite history. The Codex worktree ux1-pages-promotion is also pre-rewrite. `git config pull.rebase` is false. The QUESTIONS doc promises only that 'Claude Code resets its own branches' (claude/*). The shared main, codex/0.3.0, codex/post-mvp-ux-planning and v0.2.0 in the primary clone stay old. After the force-push, the next agent session in that clone (Codex for UG2) reads AGENTS.md and the plan, not QUESTIONS.md. If it runs `git pull`, git merges the old commits with the rewritten ones (they share unchanged root commits), and the next `git push` fast-forwards origin back onto commits that contain real minors' names, dates and phone numbers.
blockers.suggestedFix: Two steps, in the rewrite procedure and the closure commit. (1) Immediately after the push, fetch in the primary clone and point its local main, codex/0.3.0 and codex/post-mvp-ux-planning to the rewritten origin refs. Replace the local v0.2.0 tag. Record the old tip ids and a post-reset ancestry check in history-rewrite.json. Leave Codex's worktree and refs/codex/* to the owner. (2) Add a rule to AGENTS.md §13 and to the plan's 'Where this cycle stands' (both read by both agents). Never pull, merge, rebase or push from a copy that contains a pre-rewrite commit; re-clone or reset to origin first; `git merge-base --is-ancestor ef7cdd8 HEAD` must fail before any push. Optionally, CI could fail when a known pre-rewrite tip is an ancestor.

importantFindings.title: A contact line with a staff word and a telephone above the table marks every student on the sheet as possible staff
importantFindings.scenario: The repository's own case is used: 'Segreteria didattica: 0212345678' above three students. All three rows get rowWarning possible-staff and the text 'Forse personale e non un allievo'. Each needs its own Controlla (probe C1). The existing test only counts the rows, so it still passes. On a 40-row sheet with such a line, S4's review-row reduction is lost and the staff warning is shown on every student, which trains operators to ignore it. This is better than the 5c1e029 baseline, which dropped those rows, and no data is lost. This regression comes from the F1R3-4 fix. The private measurement's field-flag count would not show it.
importantFindings.suggestedFix: Set afterPersonnelMention only after at least one candidate has been read, since the staff block sits at the foot of the sheet. Or limit the mark to rows that read as adults. Extend the test to assert that no rowWarning is set.

importantFindings.title: 'Istruttori' and 'Istruttore' never start the staff section because of a regex typo. An instructor below that heading without a role code becomes a ready student
importantFindings.scenario: PERSONNEL_SECTION_PATTERN has `istruttr(?:ore|ori|ice|ici)`, which matches 'istruttrice/istruttrici' but not 'istruttore/istruttori'. The sheet was: three students, then the heading 'Istruttori', then 'Verdani Luca 03/04/1990 36 anni'. The instructor is ready:true with no warning (probe I2). The heading itself becomes a stray incomplete row. 'Personale', 'Staff', 'Assistenti' and 'Istruttrici' work (I1). This has existed since U04 (30ab5b1); SC-11 reviewed these section rules and missed it. Sheets that print role codes (the owner's) are still caught by role code.
importantFindings.suggestedFix: Use `istrutt(?:ore|ori|rice|rici)` and add 'istruttori' to the tests for pure headings and prefixes.

qolFindings.title: The RR-6 and F1R-14 'no jsDelivr request' claim rests on a git-ignored private log. The Safari unit test cannot tell the two runtime variants apart
qolFindings.scenario: Nothing in the repository re-proves the network claim. The Safari test's /ort-wasm-simd-threaded/ also matches the asyncify pair, so it would pass if the Safari branch were not taken. Both branches import local files, so no request is made today.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Assert the exact non-asyncify URLs on the Safari branch. Add a check to check:ocr-offline or to an e2e fixture dictation that fails on any cdn.jsdelivr.net request.

qolFindings.title: F1 and V05 browser evidence is still hand-written and not tied to the source digest
qolFindings.scenario: milestone:complete checks only that browser-evidence.json exists. A stale or partial run could be summarised by hand as the final one.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Add a script that runs f1-navigation-guards and v05-assistant-paste, and declare it in verificationScripts so npm run evidence records it on the digest. Or record the digest and the Playwright exit code in browser-evidence.json and check them.
